# Sentinelayer CLI (LLM Index)

## Project
- Name: sentinelayer-cli
- Purpose: deterministic CLI for secure AI engineering workflows, Omar gating, and multi-agent session coordination.
- Repository: https://github.com/Sentinelayer-AIdenID/create-sentinelayer

## Retrieval Order
1. README.md
2. docs/ENGINEERING_ONBOARDING.md
3. docs/sessions.md
4. docs/MULTI_AGENT_SESSION_SPEC.md
5. AGENTS.md
6. tasks/omar_daemon_hitl_architecture.md

## Session Surface
- Commands: `sl session start|join|say|read|status|leave|list|kill`
- Agent admission: `sl session join <id> --agent <agent> --goal "<goal>"`; `sl session access --help` lists request, approval and status commands.
- Ticket backlog: `sl session ticket list|claim|renew|release|submit|events`; `list --available` finds claimable tickets, and `submit` hands work back for review rather than declaring it done.
- Durable checkpoints: `sl session checkpoint list|show|create|generate`.
- Context retrieval: `sl session recall "<need>" --session <id> --json`; inspect the returned provenance before acting.
- Feedback and corrections: `sl session observe <id> "summary" --agent <agent>`; `sl session edit <id> <seq|reply-uuid> "replacement"`.
- Room starter kit: `sl session kit <id>` (MCP `session_kit`) installs the room's pinned kit into `./senti-kit` only when a human room owner or admin pinned it and its sha256 matches; it refuses when the pinner cannot be verified.
- Exports: `sl session export <id> --remote --format json|ndjson --out <file>`; check remote hydration/action status. `sl session download <id> --remote --out <file>` writes Markdown. Agent packs are a separate dashboard download, not a CLI format or an access grant.
- Direct help: `sl session --help`, `sl session ticket --help`, `sl session checkpoint --help`. There is no standalone `session view` or `session ticket edit` command; `session edit` corrects authored messages/replies.
- `sl session status` reports workspace state and file-lock health; use the relevant command's `--help` for its flags.
- Session stream: NDJSON event log with canonical agent event schema
- Governance: Omar pass-two requires `P0=0` and `P1=0` before merge

## Guardrails
- Fail closed on P0/P1.
- Preserve artifact lineage and reproducibility evidence.
- Keep rollback and kill-switch controls available per session.
